title: Taiwan Cement orders two bulk carriers
summary: Taiwan Cement orders two bulk carriers
body_markdown: **Taiwan:** Taiwan Cement Corporation has approved an order for two Capesize bulk carriers from China-based shipbuilder Jiangsu Hantong Shipbuilding Heavy Industry to expand its fleet capacity. The ships will be ordered via a subsidiary at a maximum price of US$81m per vessel. Each ship will have a capacity of 211,000 dwt. These kinds of vessels are commonly used to transport dry bulk commodities such as iron ore, coal, petcoke, clinker and gypsum, among other cargoes.
